fields.description: LUMENA by OMNIYAT is a commercial tower in Business Bay, combining individual and half-floor offices with a retail podium, executive clubs and wellness facilities. Shell-and-core interiors allow occupiers to plan their own workplaces within the selected unit’s approved constraints.

overview: GAD designed the tower. OMNIYAT’s current specifications list 47 levels and 19 double-deck office elevators; its certification statements describe targets, not verified awards.
research.locationNote: Business Bay, Dubai. Confirm the selected office’s entrance, permitted use, access rights and actual transit route.
research.priceLabel: Developer retained reference · project sold out
research.priceNote: The developer microsite says LUMENA is sold out but retains AED 19 million pricing. fäm lists AED 26,385,942. These references are not confirmation of available direct-developer stock or a selected-office resale quotation.
research.paymentNote: Price instalments total 100%; 4% DLD plus VAT are additional at SPA. Confirm tax basis, fees and outstanding payments.
research.handoverNote: OMNIYAT targets Q4 2029; fäm gives 30 December 2029. Neither is a completion certificate or a guarantee of the selected office’s contractual delivery.
